    How it works

    From your answers to your door.

    Six layers between your first question and a vial at your door. A licensed clinician decides if a plan is right for you.

    01

    Assess

    You take the free assessment: your goals, your age range and the medicines you take.

    SampleI don’t work out right now. Where do I start?
    02

    Review

    A licensed clinician reads it, and may ask for labs.

    Clinician network: [confirm with Grace]
    03

    Decide

    A clear yes or no, with the reasons. If it is a no, you pay nothing.

    Prepare
